title: How Gross Are You?
summary: Ten everyday habits reveal how clean, questionable or gloriously gross you really are.

landing.intro:
10 everyday habits. One revealing result.
How clean are you really?

about.body: This ten-question entertainment quiz turns ordinary private habits into a playful grossness score. Choose the answer that honestly sounds most like you. There are no correct answers and no hygiene diagnosis hiding behind the result.

steps: Answer ten quick questions about everyday habits.
Choose the option that is closest to what you really do.
Reveal your gross score, then unlock the habit that gave you away.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This quiz is not medical, hygiene or public-health advice and should not be used to judge anyone’s health.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been analysed and your grossness score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Spotless Saint
profile-1.copy: You have standards, routines and very little tolerance for suspicious smells. Even your questionable moments are probably cleaner than most people’s best behaviour.

profile-2.title: Secretly Questionable
profile-2.copy: You look respectable, but a few private shortcuts tell another story. Nothing alarming—just enough to make you avoid answering certain questions in public.

profile-3.title: Everyday Gross
profile-3.copy: You sit comfortably in the very human middle: mostly presentable, occasionally questionable and fully capable of pretending you did not see that crumb.

profile-4.title: Full Goblin Mode
profile-4.copy: Convenience often wins, the sniff test counts as science and some cleaning jobs can always wait until tomorrow. You are not ashamed; you are efficient.

profile-5.title: The Biohazard Legend
profile-5.copy: You chose chaos with remarkable consistency. Your habits are bold, your standards are flexible and at least one answer deserves to remain between you and this quiz.

reviewUnlock.title: Reveal Your Grossest Habit
reviewUnlock.copy: One answer pushed your score further than the others. Unlock the full pattern and see which private habit gave you away.
reviewUnlock.adNote: One short ad, then see your full breakdown.
reviewUnlock.raisedCopy: This answer nudged your gross score upward.
reviewUnlock.loweredCopy: This answer pulled your gross score downward.
reviewUnlock.neutralCopy: This answer sat close to the everyday middle.

grossquiz-q1.question: Food hits the floor. What happens next?

answers.a1: It goes straight in the bin
answers.a2: I’ll eat it if the floor looks clean
answers.a4: I inspect it, shrug and eat it

grossquiz-q2.question: How often do your bedsheets actually get changed?

answers.a4: When I can no longer ignore them

grossquiz-q3.question: Your phone comes into the bathroom with you. Then what?

answers.a3: I wipe it when I remember
answers.a4: It has never knowingly been cleaned

grossquiz-q4.question: How far past its date will you eat something?

answers.a1: I usually stay within the date
answers.a2: A little past if it smells fine
answers.a3: Well past if it still looks normal
answers.a4: I remove the questionable bit and carry on

grossquiz-q5.question: How long can one bath towel stay in service?

answers.a4: Until it develops its own personality

grossquiz-q6.question: How do you handle a day when you cannot be bothered to shower?

answers.a3: Deodorant and clean clothes will do
answers.a4: If nobody complains, the streak continues

grossquiz-q7.question: What is your relationship with nail biting or skin picking?

grossquiz-q8.question: When did you last properly clean your phone screen?

answers.a3: Only when the marks become obvious
answers.a4: I cannot remember ever doing it

grossquiz-q9.question: You taste food while cooking. What happens to the spoon?

answers.a1: I grab a clean one next time
answers.a3: I use the same spoon again
answers.a4: Back into the pot it goes—repeatedly

grossquiz-q10.question: Final confession: which private habit sounds most like you?

answers.a1: Sniff-testing clothes before wearing them again
answers.a2: Eating crumbs directly from the sofa or bed
answers.a3: Picking something and inspecting the evidence
answers.a4: Doing something gross, then checking whether anyone saw
